baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled bi-l-haqq around anzalnahu and nazala.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first clause names caused delivery and the second realized descent; repeating the same truth-frame makes source act, transfer, and arrival answer to one standard.

activation_trace.role: Truth as stable correspondence to reality qualifies both the initiating act and the completed descent.
Causing and conveying something down supplies the sender-facing side of the transfer.
Descent and settling supply the event-facing side, so arrival is asserted as well as authorization.

changed_reading.before: A true message was sent down.
changed_reading.after: Truth characterizes the whole transfer: it was rightly made to descend and actually arrived and settled without a break between authorization and event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same object is made to descend and then descends, each time with bi-l-haqq.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fit-joint image of haqq and the emplacement branch of n-z-l allow truth to name exact placement, not only accurate content.

activation_trace.role: A right that fits its locus like a joint or vessel supplies the image of exact correspondence to place.
Putting something in its proper station turns descent into ordered emplacement.

changed_reading.before: A true text came from above.
changed_reading.after: The message is installed in a fitting station and order; haqq can mark the rightness of its placement as well as its assertions.

baseline_models.mechanism: The exception bounds the dispatch to carrying a paired report: one edge opens joy and the other wakes protective caution. It assigns communication, not control of response or outcome.

activation_trace.role: The messenger and carried message define an embassy whose core function is transmission.
News that opens the face with joy supplies the hopeful edge of the carried report.
Notice of danger that awakens caution supplies the protective warning edge.

changed_reading.before: The messenger gives good news and warning.
changed_reading.after: The envoy is expressly limited to a two-edged communicative office: opening hope and making danger early enough to be guarded against.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first context cue maps h-d-y both to gentle direction toward path and truth and, through a non-dominant h-d-d target, to threat, while d-l-l marks loss of the intended way. The focus pair can therefore be carried as two registers of one directional intervention.

activation_trace.role: The carried message anchors both registers in one dispatched office.
Joy-opening news supplies the gentle, inviting register.
Danger-notice that awakens caution supplies the threatening register.
Gentle indication toward the path and truth makes the paired office directional guidance.
The split target's threat and warning image activates the severe register inside the same guidance occurrence.
Departure from guidance and intended direction supplies the fork at which both registers operate.

structural_cues: 17:97 immediately precedes the focus mission with guidance versus straying, then stages failed sight, speech, and hearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one guidance occurrence split between gentle direction and threat; I infer that these registers echo mubashshir and nadhir. The live alternative is that the h-d-d target is only a form-distant mapping artifact.

changed_reading.before: Good news and warning are opposite kinds of message.
changed_reading.after: They may be gentle and severe modes of the same guidance act, each trying to orient a hearer at a live route-fork.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense answers action, inert remains are stirred, creation is renewed, and an appointed term bounds arrival. The warning edge thus bears an event that will publicly verify the descended truth.

activation_trace.role: Establishing and displaying truth lets haqq move from accurate report toward realized verification.
Actual descent and arrival anchor verification in an event rather than an assertion alone.
Advance danger-notice makes the warning a temporal leading edge of what will occur.
An act answered by its recompense supplies event-level correspondence between deed and outcome.
Stirring what is still from rest supplies the transition from denied possibility to enacted resurrection.
Bringing creation into existence makes the warned renewal an executable act.
A fixed terminal time gives the warning a bounded horizon for realization.

structural_cues: 17:98-99 moves from denial of renewed creation to the Creator's capacity and an appointed term without doubt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deed-answering recompense, reactivation, creation, and a fixed limit; I supply the arrow from those events back to haqq as verified performance. Haqq as propositional accuracy remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The message is true and contains a warning.
changed_reading.after: Its truth is event-bearing: the warning arrives verbally before a recompense and renewal that will make the report true in public history.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's delivery and dispatch stand against the imagined human ownership of mercy stores, holding them back for fear of outflow. Revelation becomes a divine anti-withholding act that puts truth and mercy into circulation.

activation_trace.role: Conveying something down supplies positive delivery from source to recipients.
Dispatch, release, and letting go explicitly oppose restraint and anchor the circulation model.
Possession with power of disposal supplies the counterfactual control over the stores.
Guarding and storing supplies the contained stock from which release is withheld.
Mercy and tenderness identify the stored good whose divine release reframes the message.
Holding wealth out of stinginess supplies the exact negative of dispatch and delivery.
The going-out of wealth in expenditure supplies the feared outward flow.
Constriction and reduction name the human narrowing that revelation reverses.

structural_cues: 17:100 says that if the hearers controlled the treasuries of mercy, they would hold back for fear of expenditure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy as guarded stock, possessive control, holding, feared expenditure, and constriction; I infer an antithesis between that pattern and the focus's release and descent. The live alternative confines 17:100 to material generosity.

changed_reading.before: God sends a true message to people.
changed_reading.after: The descent and envoy enact unhoarded mercy: truth is released from source into human circulation despite the impulse to retain and narrow.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs are publicly queryable, yet Pharaoh's accusatory relabeling coexists with Moses's claim that he knew who sent down the insights. Truth secures disclosure and evidence integrity, not compelled interpretation by the recipient.

activation_trace.role: Stable correspondence to reality grounds the evidence independently of a hearer's verdict.
A carrier of a message is responsible for delivery, not for forcing its classification.
Appearance and disclosure make the signs manifest rather than privately asserted.
Questioning and requesting make the evidence open to testimonial inquiry.
Accusation supplies a recipient-generated classification that can resist manifest evidence.
Diversion and deception supply the hostile label applied to the messenger.
Disclosure to a knower supplies recognized evidence beneath the public accusation.
The context's own caused descent links the signs directly to the focus transfer.
Insight of the heart identifies the signs as instruments of inward discernment.

structural_cues: 17:101 invites inquiry about clear signs; 17:102 juxtaposes 'you knew,' caused descent, and insights with the prior charge of bewitchment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manifest and queryable signs, hostile relabeling, knowledge, and inward insight; I infer that truth guarantees evidence integrity while leaving assent unforced. The alternative is that the exchange indicts Pharaoh alone without defining the focus mission.

changed_reading.before: A true descent should make its truth self-evident to everyone.
changed_reading.after: The descent can be wholly in truth while a recipient relabels it; the bounded envoy discloses and warns but does not compel the act of recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah gathers the object as recitation, separates it into parts, places its reading over people with waiting, and intensifies repeated descent. Segmentation and delay become part of how the transfer fits its recipients.

activation_trace.role: Tightly composed speech supports a transfer whose temporal construction is itself exact.
Putting something in its proper station opens descent toward ordered installation.
Reading, reciting, and causing recitation identify the descended object as an iterated voiced delivery.
Dispersal into parts supplies staged rather than undifferentiated delivery.
Stability with waiting supplies the receiving tempo between installments.
The intensive verb and verbal noun restate caused descent as sustained or repeated conveyance.

structural_cues: 17:106 immediately identifies a Qur'an, its separation, recitation over people, waiting, and the emphatic nzzalnahu tanzila.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation, recitation, waiting, and emphatic repeated descent; I infer that cadence helps enact the focus's truth-fit. The live alternative treats timing as pedagogy without extending the force of haqq.

changed_reading.before: The message descended as a completed one-time transfer.
changed_reading.after: Its truthful arrival is serial installation: division, voiced repetition, and waiting are part of a delivery fitted to human reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing denial of partner in dominion or supporting ally, followed by magnification, sharpens the focus exception into a sender-carrier distinction. The envoy bears authority as message, not sovereignty as source.

activation_trace.role: The messenger as carrier of another's statement anchors a delegated, non-sovereign office.
Denied partnership prevents the dispatched carrier from sharing the sender's dominion.
Sovereignty and rule identify the authority reserved to the sender.
Denied supporting alliance removes any model of divine dependence on an envoy or protector.
Majesty and greatness direct magnification beyond the carrier to the sovereign source.

structural_cues: 17:111 closes the unit by denying child, partner in dominion, and ally from abasement, then commands emphatic magnification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exclusive dominion and magnification; I infer that the focus's 'only' also protects the distinction between sovereign sender and dispatched carrier. The alternative reads the closure as doxology without a direct office contrast.

changed_reading.before: The messenger's task is limited to good news and warning.
changed_reading.after: The limitation is also theological: the carrier transmits sovereign authority without becoming a partner in the source's rule.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps textual descent onto population movement. It remains anchored in the focus's proper-emplacement branches and in the nearby dislodging, settling, bringing, and mixed gathering sequence; render it only as a spatial analogy, not as a claim that 17:105 lexically denotes a political program.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Haqq as fitting locus and n-z-l as putting something in its station.

activation_trace.role: Fit between a right and its locus supplies the criterion of rightful placement.
Putting something in its proper station anchors the analogy in the focus descent.
Lightness that shakes stability supplies the attempted coercive dislodgment.
Dwelling in a settled home supplies the counter-movement of emplacement.
Bringing and making present supply the promised return movement.
Mixed elements wrapped into one gathering supply the terminal reassembly.

changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial analogy, truth descends by putting what has been shaken loose into fitting relation and promised reassembly.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The vertical echo is cross-domain and does not prove a lexical relation between revelation and prostration. It remains valid because focus n-z-l explicitly supplies downward arrival and the receiving sequence twice supplies falling, chinward abasement, tears, and humility; render it as a possible embodied resonance, not a causal law.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Nazala as downward arrival and settling.

activation_trace.role: Downward movement and settling provide the vertical vector that the reception scene echoes.
One sound following another supplies the recited sequence that carries the message into bodies.
Audible, unsteady falling makes reception continue the downward vector.
Lowering and submission turn physical descent into receptive posture.
The repeated fall confirms that the bodily downward motion is structurally emphasized.
Tears, grief, and voice make the reception materially visible.
Lowering and submission name the inward posture produced alongside the bodily fall.

changed_reading.before: The descended message reaches hearers as information.
changed_reading.after: For prepared hearers, its downward arrival may continue as an embodied descent: recited sound is answered by falling, tears, and increased inward lowering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This extends a prayer-specific vocal instruction to the messenger's paired proclamation, so it is not a direct syntactic gloss of 17:105. It remains anchored in r-s-l's deliberative speech branch and the focus's verbal offices, with the context's explicit loud/low middle path; render it as delivery ethics, not a rule that every warning must use one volume.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The messenger is sent only as mubashshir and nadhir, while r-s-l includes deliberation in speech and reading.

activation_trace.role: Deliberation, measured speech, and unhurried reading anchor vocal calibration in the dispatched office.
Hope-bearing news supplies one content pole that still requires audible delivery.
Danger-notice supplies the urgent pole without itself requiring maximal loudness.
Public announcement and raised voice supply one rejected vocal extreme.
Secret or lowered utterance supplies the other rejected vocal extreme.
A condition between two limits supplies the calibrated middle.
A traversable extended path turns moderation into a deliberate delivery route.

changed_reading.before: Heralding and warning differ chiefly by content.
changed_reading.after: As a contained extension, the paired office also has an acoustic ethic: make hope and danger audible through a measured path between coercive volume and disappearance.

strongest_changes: The double truth/descent frame became transfer integrity and eventual public verification, not content accuracy alone.
17:106 made segmentation, waiting, recitation, and repeated descent part of truth-fitted delivery.
The paired messenger office became bounded two-register guidance whose evidence can remain true without compelling assent.
summary.what_was_special: The non-dominant h-d-y to h-d-d threat branch made warning a severe register within guidance; the mercy-treasury sequence activated revelation as anti-withholding release, while emplacement and bodily falling preserved two stranger spatial echoes.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the h-d-d target is a meaningful activation or only a form-distant mapping artifact.
Whether release, historical emplacement, and bodily descent are productive mechanisms or contextual analogies that downstream prose should omit.
How much identification of the focus pronoun with the Qur'an depends on the immediately following 17:106 rather than the focus alone.
